name: claude-in-codex
description: Use Claude Code from Codex: delegate coding tasks with independently verified results, get Claude code reviews, pair Claude with Codex, and run Claude/Codex/Gemini councils, with automatic Haiku/Sonnet/Opus routing.

interface.longDescription: Hand coding tasks to headless Claude Code with automatic Haiku/Sonnet/Opus routing, independent verification, and repair retries; get Claude reviews of local changes; hold persistent multi-turn sessions; steer or cancel running jobs; run Claude/Codex pair-programming loops and Claude/Codex/Gemini councils; and connect agents over a local message bus. Requires the cic CLI (install.sh, or uv tool install git+https://github.com/prashan-s/claude-in-codex then cic setup) and a logged-in Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Use $claude-delegate to have Claude fix the failing test and verify it.
Use $claude-review to get Claude's review of my uncommitted changes.
Use $claude-council to compare our options with Claude, Codex, and Gemini.
